QuestInfo.name: Olaf's First Training
QuestInfo.0: It seems like #p107# in #m10000000# has something to say to the beginner adventurers who have just arrived on Victoria Island.
QuestInfo.1: I met #p107# at #m10000000#. #p107# mentioned that I could get a job advancement once I reach level 10, but he wasn't sure if I truly have what it takes. To prove myself, #p107# told me to hunt monsters outside the village. I'm a bit nervous, since the monsters on Victoria Island seem really strong...
QuestInfo.2: I successfully passed #p107#'s training. But is this really enough?

0.0: So, you're a fresh-faced adventurer who just landed on Victoria Island, huh? Doesn't matter what you say, it's obvious you're a newbie from a mile away! You might've done well on Maple Island, but here? Hold your horses. If you keep wandering around like that, you'll be face down in the dirt before you know it. You gotta get your head in the game!
0.1: Maybe things will change once you hit #blevel 10#k and get a job advancement, but I'm not so sure you've earned it yet... Fine! I'll give you some special training to see what you've got. How about it?

yes.0: Outside #m10000000#, you'll find monsters that you've never even seen before on Maple Island. Take down #r8 #o6#s and 8 #o7#s#k. They're no pushovers, so don't forget to grab some potions from the shop!

no.0: What's the matter? Getting cold feet about the training? Hahaha! Don't worry; you can come back when you're ready!

1.0: Well, look who's back. I honestly thought you might've bailed. All right, let's see if you actually finished the job.

yes.0: You did that flawlessly, huh? Nice! It's been a while since I've seen such an eager newbie adventurer. You've got me feeling good! Here, take this special item and put it to good use on your journey!

mob.0: Hmm... looks like you didn't take down all the monsters I asked you to. If you're even one short, that's a no-go!
